ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food/ PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Food/ PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food/ PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food/ PRACTICES.

3. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

5. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.

7. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our Home? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our Home.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our Home.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Our Home.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our Home.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to PRACTICES.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for PRACTICES.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on PRACTICES.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Toileting PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Toileting PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Toileting PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Toileting PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Toileting PRACTICES.

14. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

15. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. A mixture of two liquids

16. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Producers

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Safety In and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Myself ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Our ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Our Home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain People found at home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to; and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
